mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dossier_files (dir_id, file_path, file_name, file_size, source_type, status, created_at) VALUES (#{dirId}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dossier_files WHERE dir_id = #{dirId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY file_name
SELECT * FROM dossier_files WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
